title: Reborn into a World of Yanderes?!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A family is reborn together into the world of an otome game whose love interests are yandere (obsessively devoted) characters, and they use memories of their past lives to steer the heroine away from the game's 'bad ending'. The seven-volume shoujo adaptation of a light novel follows the lead from childhood through a boarding-school setting and an engagement (MangaUpdates categories).
life_message: Knowledge, family teamwork and deliberate choices can rewrite a fate that seems fixed.
